style: Say curiously and warmly, like a friendly school librarian
lines: Let’s build a paragraph burger! Pick a sentence, then choose where it goes.
Now write your own burger. Type a top bun, three fillings and a bottom bun.
Pick a sentence. Does it go on the top bun, in the middle, or on the bottom bun?
An empty plate? Pick a sentence and put it on the burger first.
Where’s the top bun? A paragraph starts with a topic sentence that tells what it’s about.
No bottom bun! A closing sentence holds the whole paragraph together.
Just bread? Add more details to the middle. Two or three is just right.
Hmm. That top bun doesn’t tell me what the whole paragraph is about.
Hmm. That bottom bun doesn’t wrap things up. Which sentence sounds like an ending?
That one sounds like a bun, not a filling. Try moving it.
The steps are mixed up! Stack them in order: first, next, last.
Mmm! Topic, details and a closing. A perfect paragraph burger!
A boot?! That sentence isn’t about dogs. Take it off the burger!
Dogs make great pets.
A dog will play fetch with you all afternoon.
Dogs keep your family safe by barking when someone comes to the door.
A dog is always happy to see you when you get home.
That is why a dog is the best pet you can have.
My aunt has a shiny red car.
Pizza is my favorite lunch.
A boot?! That sentence isn’t about fall. Take it off the burger!
Fall is the best season of the year.
The leaves turn red, orange and yellow.
You can jump into big, crunchy piles of leaves.
Picking apples on a cool day is so much fun.
Fall is full of colors, games and treats.
Sharks have rows of sharp teeth.
My little brother loves video games.
A boot?! That sentence isn’t about planting a seed. Take it off the burger!
Planting a seed is easy if you follow three steps.
First, fill a cup with soil.
Next, push the seed into the soil with your finger.
Last, water it and set it in a sunny window.
Soon you will see a tiny green sprout!
Penguins cannot fly.
We went to the beach in July.
A boot?! That sentence isn’t about recess. Take it off the burger!
Recess is my favorite part of the school day.
I get to run and play tag with my friends.
The swings make me feel like I am flying.
Fresh air helps me think when I go back to class.
Recess makes the whole day better.
The moon goes around the Earth.
Grandma makes soup on Sundays.
